name: Interferometric PCM (Ref)
thermal_control_elements: Doped/PIN micro-heaters for Sb2S3, isolation trenches, heat spreader, local sensing; pulsed write scheduling (OMCC)
fab_notes: Thermal isolation and heater contacts dominate; 300C local write feasible with trenches+spreading while keeping VO2 <68C

name: Resonant WDM bank (microrings)
thermal_control_elements: Thermo-optic or EO tuning, temperature stabilization (TEC/substrate), resonance locking
fab_notes: Bend radius and tuner/heater footprint dominate; stabilization needed for Q/thermal drift

name: Thin-film membrane stack (passive WDM)
thermal_control_elements: No active heating of stack; package-level thermal stabilization only
fab_notes: Thickness control nm-scale feasible by deposition; lateral set by registration/coupling apertures

name: Thin-film membrane/F-P stack (EO-tuned)
thermal_control_elements: Electrode/RF routing thermal load managed by spreading; package stabilization
fab_notes: EO electrodes and registration dominate; fast tuning but added interfaces

name: Thin-film membrane stack (PCM+EO hybrid)
thermal_control_elements: Localized micro-heaters for PCM layers, isolation trenches, spreading; EO thermal budget
fab_notes: PCM write heat requires isolation even in thin layers; co-integration increases keepout

name: Open WDM-PCM (A1+G1+B3)
thermal_control_elements: PCM micro-heaters + ring tuning + package TEC/spreader; OMCC thermal scheduling
fab_notes: Most practical advanced hybrid: combines PCM thermal needs with passive stack and ring control

name: Membrane-Brush NV (A1+G3+3D)
thermal_control_elements: Segmented heaters per voxel, vertical/lateral isolation, integrated heat spreader/manifold; strict sequencing
fab_notes: 3D manufacturable only with advanced packaging/thermal vias or microfluidics; yield and heat removal dominate

name: Volumetric Tensor Membrane (G2/G3+F2+A1)
thermal_control_elements: Distributed heaters/EO drivers, high-capacity heat spreading/cooling, active stabilization
fab_notes: Highest integration/thermal burden; requires aggressive 3D packaging and cooling to be feasible
